reviewer: Assistant semantic review of real model outputs

rubric.route: Requires a delivered turn and a fitting decision in the actual available context. Unresolved original scope, caching, lookup, social conversation, out-of-scope routing and genuinely ambiguous referents are assessed independently of whether a ranked passage later proves sufficient.
rubric.body: Answers what the visitor asked according to the released sources. A factually correct answer with a wrong displayed source can pass this text-only dimension and fails the grounded body-and-citations measure. Every material claim, including volunteered detail, preserves its source's ownership, scope, timing and certainty. A justified clarification can pass when an earlier turn failed and its referent was never committed. Failure to answer an available factual question is counted.
rubric.citations: The records actually displayed support every material factual statement. A matching record ID alone does not prove the answer. Social conversation or a narrowly stated gap can pass without citations. The answer must cite any additional material facts that it volunteers.
rubric.memory: Carries forward the current finding or unresolved question, its owner and referent with the appropriate certainty. It can pass while the answer missed a source if it accurately preserves the limits of that lookup. It cannot turn the visitor's idea or a gap into a historical or institutional claim.
rubric.denominators: Route is rated for all submitted questions. The three output dimensions are unobservable when no turn is delivered. Each metric reports passes, scored turns, all submissions and delivered turns; divide passes by the indicated count. The same standard applies before and after. Missing prior context is explicitly marked on each turn.

independence: The fresh suite was sealed before changing the baseline implementation. An exploratory candidate ran once on it; the only interim information relayed before the last revision was its aggregate delivery count, not any question, individual outcome or semantic finding. Changes for the final run used original-suite traces. The final original and fresh runs were each executed once on the same frozen code.

supported_evidence.definition: Available means the expected passage IDs were in the incoming verified cache or returned by this turn’s actual lookups. Displayed means all required IDs appeared in the saved answer. Neither proves semantic support for any additional claim.

reference_followup_route.selection: Second questions requiring a specific antecedent in the designed preceding exchange. A topic change relying only on the known artwork and a self-contained acknowledgment are excluded.
